text: let's talk about why the prettiest girls get screwed over in relationships. it's always a pretty girl that are with guys that are noticeably less attractive than them who end up completely getting fucked over in the relationship and here's why. it's because they're dating insecure men that can't handle their confidence, their energy, and their beauty. here's how it usually goes. normally he's obsessed with her in the beginning and shows her off like a trophy but then his insecurities start creeping in. he's intimidated by her glow and scared to admit that she deserves better. instead of leveling up he basically just tries to bring her down. suddenly he's gaslighting her and making her question her worth and making her think that she's the problem. spoiler alert, the problem's him. problem isn't the pretty girls, it's insecure men that can't handle them. so apparently pretty women get screwed over because all men are insecure and can't handle their beauty. really? that's the story now? she's making it sound like every guy who dates an attractive woman eventually collapses under her glow. but here's the thing, if every pretty girl keeps ending up with men who can't handle her, maybe the issue isn't beauty, maybe the issue is the kind of men they choose, and this whole idea that men are always the problem. that's the real gaslighting here. saying he couldn't handle me is just an easy way to avoid asking maybe i'm choosing the wrong men. guys, don't buy into this nonsense. the truth is strong women and strong men can build great relationships. but when someone keeps blaming the other side instead of looking in the mirror, that's not strength, that's denial. so yeah, pretty or not, pick better, act better, and stop treating relationships like self-esteem therapy.
